info.description:
API for immutable truck IN/OUT movements and pool operations.
Movement scans require `unitlog:app:default:view`, actor ID/name claims, and an Idempotency-Key UUID. Operations require `unitlog:web:default:view`.
info.title: UnitLog Pool Basirih API

get.description: Returns document data and backend-derived allowedOutDestinations. An empty array prevents a new SPP OUT but does not invalidate a returning-IN lookup. Submit always revalidates current eligibility.

get.summary: Look up a scanned work order

post.description: Records an IN or OUT transaction after document lookup or unit/driver selection. A returning IN must submit the same WO/SPP as its open OUT; OTHER is required when returning from OTHER. Retries must reuse the same Idempotency-Key and request body.

get.summary: List units for the movement picker

coordinates.description: Optional for IN and OUT. Signed decimal latitude,longitude; omitted, null, or blank means unavailable. No geofence is applied.

direction.description: Required for all movements. IN requires inCategory and exactly one source: workOrderNumber, sppNumber, or OTHER fields. OUT requires outDestination and its matching fields.

driverId.description: Required for OTHER movements in either direction.

driverName.description: Required for OTHER movements in either direction.

inCategory.description: Required only for IN. Must not be supplied for OUT.

noLambung.description: Required for all movements. Populate from a document lookup or unit picker; do not derive it from a unit QR scan.

note.description: Required for OTHER movements in either direction; optional for document-backed OUT movements.

outDestination.description: Required only for OUT. Must not be supplied for IN.

sppNumber.description: Required for FILLING_SHED_KUIN or CUSTOMER OUT and a returning IN for either SPP departure.

workOrderNumber.description: Required for BENGKEL_LUAR OUT and a returning IN for a BENGKEL_LUAR departure.

allowedOutDestinations.description: Always present, including [] when this valid SPP cannot be used for OUT. Does not restrict returning IN.

BearerAuth.description: Auth Service JWT using the `Bearer <token>` format.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
